easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
